title: Seam contract
description: Six answers plus a rehearsal date, as defined in The Software Field Guide, chapter 'Segmenting the Estate': entry, decision, monitoring, blast radius, kill path, and when the kill path was last rehearsed.

seam.description: Name of the seam. Must appear in the owning enclave's borderInventory.

enclave.description: Name of the enclave that owns this seam.

entry.description: How traffic and identity arrive at the seam. The validator warns when no identity mechanism (auth, mTLS, SVID, token, identity) is named.

decision.description: Who gets in and who is denied. The validator warns when no deny rule is stated.

monitoring.description: How the seam is watched. The validator warns when no observation (log, metric, alert, monitor) is named.

blastRadius.description: What it means, concretely, when this seam fails.

killPath.description: How the seam is shut down.

lastRehearsed.description: Date the kill path was last rehearsed, YYYY-MM-DD. The validator flags rehearsals older than 180 days and dates in the future.

reviewDate.description: Date of the next scheduled review, YYYY-MM-DD. The validator flags review dates already in the past.
